description: Header file defining the CryptoUtils class with static cryptographic helper functions for QUIC protocol, including key derivation, validation, and nonce generation.

classes.name: CryptoUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static cryptographic helper functions for QUIC, including key derivation, validation, and nonce generation.

classes.name: CryptoUtils::Diversification
classes.description: A nested class representing key diversification modes and associated data for QUIC cryptography.

methods.name: CryptoUtils()
methods.description: Deleted constructor to prevent instantiation.

methods.name: Diversification Never()
methods.description: Creates a Diversification instance with mode NEVER.

methods.name: Diversification Pending()
methods.description: Creates a Diversification instance with mode PENDING.

methods.name: Diversification Now(DiversificationNonce* nonce)
methods.description: Creates a Diversification instance with mode NOW and associated nonce.

methods.name: mode()
methods.description: Returns the current diversification mode.

methods.name: nonce()
methods.description: Returns the nonce associated with the diversification, valid only if mode is NOW.

methods.name: InitializeCrypterSecrets
methods.description: Derives key, IV, and header protection key from the packet protection secret and sets them on the crypter.

methods.name: SetKeyAndIV
methods.description: Derives and sets the key and IV on the given crypter from the packet protection secret.

methods.name: GenerateHeaderProtectionKey
methods.description: Generates the header protection key from the packet protection secret.

methods.name: GenerateNextKeyPhaseSecret
methods.description: Derives the secret for the next key phase.

methods.name: CreateInitialObfuscators
methods.description: Creates encrypter and decrypter objects for initial packet protection based on connection ID and version.

methods.name: ValidateRetryIntegrityTag
methods.description: Validates the integrity tag of a retry packet.

methods.name: GenerateNonce
methods.description: Generates a connection nonce based on current time, orbit, and randomness.

methods.name: DeriveKeys
methods.description: Derives encryption keys, IVs, and subkey secrets for QUIC based on various inputs and key diversification mode.

methods.name: ComputeLeafCertHash
methods.description: Computes FNV-1a hash of DER-encoded certificate for XLCT tag.

methods.name: ValidateServerHello
methods.description: Validates server hello message and checks for downgrade attacks.

methods.name: ValidateServerHelloVersions
methods.description: Validates server version list against negotiated versions to prevent downgrade attacks.

methods.name: ValidateClientHello
methods.description: Validates client hello message and checks for downgrade attacks.

methods.name: ValidateClientHelloVersion
methods.description: Checks if client version indicates a downgrade attack.

methods.name: ValidateChosenVersion
methods.description: Checks if the version from version info matches the session version.

methods.name: ValidateServerVersions
methods.description: Checks for downgrade attacks involving version negotiation.

methods.name: HandshakeFailureReasonToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of handshake failure reasons.

methods.name: EarlyDataReasonToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of SSL early data reasons.

methods.name: HashHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Computes hash of serialized handshake message.

methods.name: GetSSLCapabilities
methods.description: Serializes SSL capabilities.

methods.name: GenerateProofPayloadToBeSigned
methods.description: Generates payload for signature inside QUIC crypto protocol.
